title: Repair fragile anchor transfer with paid random-line source correction
statement: For a fixed source beta-close to a degree-D polynomial over F_p^n with p>2(D+1), beta<=1/[8(D+1)], D+1 nonzero points on a random native line recover any requested polynomial value with probability>=7/8. Fresh repeated lines recover r pivot values with failure<=r*exp(-9L/32).

requires: The stated near-polynomial condition for coverage, native uniform direction sampling, exact finite-field values, actual source access and paid known-program pivot selection.
provides: For a fixed source beta-close to a degree-D polynomial over F_p^n with p>2(D+1), beta<=1/[8(D+1)], D+1 nonzero points on a random native line recover any requested polynomial value with probability>=7/8. Fresh repeated lines recover r pivot values with failure<=r*exp(-9L/32).
assumptions: Persistent source corruption is allowed but the source is fixed; directions are fresh independent. No latent sampler, extension-field oracle, free derivative or source reset. Outside coverage, target guards still determine whether a returned candidate is supported.
costs: Zero-failure guards cost r*q values with q>=ln(1/delta)/eta; tolerant guards use q>=12*ln(1/min(delta,zeta0))/eta per source. Near-family transfer costs r(D+1)L with odd L>=32*ln(r/zeta)/9, plus fresh target guards. Language dimension M=binom(n+D,D), pivot search up to M*r known evaluations, inversion O(r^3), target solve O(r^2), code evaluation, field bit arithmetic, sampling/rejection caps, failed cohorts and fits all remain paid. r versus M is not total-runtime superiority.
contract.units: Finite-field outputs use log2(p) bits; eta,tau,beta and risks are dimensionless disagreement probabilities under the declared native law. r,M,D,L,q count dimensions/degrees/directions/actual values, not equal-cost hardware operations.
contract.obstruction: Acquire a useful language and related future tasks with actual return power and full amortized costs. Longer interactive use needs deterministic finite-horizon input-domination/risk caps. No physical learning system, new primitive priority or universal scientific discovery capability is established.

body: For each j=1,...,D+1, x+j*v is uniform, so union bound gives line failure<=(D+1)*beta<=1/8 without assuming within-line independence. Interpolate degree D in j and evaluate at0. An odd number L of independent direction estimates has majority error<=exp(-9L/32). Correct r known unisolvent pivot values, solve A*c and compile the learned combination. A source equal1 except0 at a chosen raw anchor shows why average closeness alone cannot justify uncorrected fitting. All calls/field work and a fresh final guard are charged.
